name: Salicylic acid (BHA)
function: Helps clear follicular plugs and exfoliate oily skin.
cautions: May dry or sting; avoid with salicylate allergy.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Benzoyl peroxide
function: Reduces acne-associated bacteria and inflammatory lesions.
cautions: May irritate skin and bleach fabrics.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Adapalene
function: Retinoid that normalizes follicular shedding and helps prevent acne.
cautions: Avoid in pregnancy or when planning pregnancy; introduce gradually.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Azelaic acid
cautions: Temporary stinging can occur; start slowly.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Niacinamide
function: Supports barrier function and may improve oiliness and uneven tone.
cautions: High concentrations can sting sensitive skin.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Zinc PCA
function: May help oily skin; clinical evidence is limited.
cautions: Patch test; benefits vary by formulation.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Glycolic acid (AHA)
function: Exfoliates surface skin for uneven texture and tone.
cautions: Can irritate and increase sun sensitivity; do not layer exfoliating acids.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Lactic acid (AHA)
cautions: Can irritate and increase sun sensitivity; do not layer exfoliating acids.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Retinol
function: May improve fine lines and uneven texture over time.
cautions: Avoid in pregnancy or when planning pregnancy; dryness is common initially.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Vitamin C
function: Antioxidant support and potential improvement in uneven tone.
cautions: Acidic formulations can sting; potency and stability vary.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Tranexamic acid
function: Topical option for uneven pigmentation; evidence is still developing.
cautions: Patch test; persistent pigment changes need professional assessment.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Hyaluronic acid
function: Humectant that improves temporary surface hydration.
cautions: Apply with moisturizer; does not permanently remove wrinkles.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Ceramides
function: Support the skin lipid barrier and reduce moisture loss.
cautions: Choose a formulation suited to your skin; patch test.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Panthenol
function: Humectant supporting comfort and barrier care.
cautions: Rare contact allergy is possible; stop if irritation develops.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Centella asiatica
function: May soothe skin; evidence and extract composition vary.
cautions: Botanical extracts can cause contact allergy.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

name: Broad-spectrum sunscreen SPF 30+
function: Reduces UV exposure contributing to pigment changes and photoaging.
cautions: Apply generously and reapply per label; patch test sensitive skin.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.
